# Topology-aware approach to path-signature time-series forecasting

A concept shared by **62** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #4,002. The CSV rates every member: *Low confidence — reconstructed from the algorithm title; executable rules and source support are not established.* None is implemented in volatility-ai.

## Description

Proposed topology-aware approach to path-signature time-series forecasting: Encode the ordered evolution of multivariate market data with path-signature features and use them to forecast a defined target; the asset, horizon, and conversion of forecasts into trades remain unspecified. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
